question: Mission "SAGAR" is an initiative launched by which of the following country to extend necessary assistance, including medical and food supplies to countries in Indian Ocean Region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Mission SAGAR** (Security and Growth for All in the Region) is an initiative launched by the **Government of India** in **May 2020** to provide assistance to countries in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**. 
• The mission primarily focuses on delivering critical assistance, including **medical supplies, food, and essential goods**, to IOR countries during emergencies like the **COVID-19 pandemic**. 
• Under this initiative, India has extended its support to several nations, including **Maldives, Sri Lanka, Seychelles, Mauritius, and Madagascar**, showcasing its commitment to regional cooperation and security. 
• **INS Kesari**, an Indian naval ship, was deployed for Mission SAGAR to deliver medical and humanitarian aid
